normalization.accepted: Four-digit Gregorian calendar date, uppercase T, hour00-23/minute00-59/second00-59, optional decimal fractional digits, UTC suffix Z or +00:00. Leap-second spelling and unknown offset -00:00 are rejected, matching the pinned Go time parser domain.
normalization.equivalence: Only insignificant trailing fractional zeros are removed; an all-zero fraction is omitted. Every significant digit and original UTC suffix is retained.
normalization.otherMetadata: All other metadata, ordering, relationship and transaction/proof comparisons retain v1 semantics.
normalization.rawRecords: Preserved byte-for-byte; projection never edits input.

goProvenance.serialization: HistoryNote.MarshalJSON delegates When to json.Marshal, which may omit insignificant fractional zeros.

runtimePrecondition.cli: Only v2 child processes receive TZ=UTC; direct v2 API rejects missing or mismatched observations before service startup.
runtimePrecondition.scope: Controlled UTC reference environment; non-UTC source history is outside this profile, retained as a failed engineering attempt.
